title: Daande ko yiyaaka
intro: E nder annal jokkondiral diine, limre ina seerti e daartol mum, ina waɗi maandeeji kaawisaaji e goonɗinal tiiɗngal. Oo neɗɗo heɓiino wahyu keeriiɗo, luulndiiɗo noddaango jamaanu maɓɓe, haaloowo gila e mbaydi teskinndi. Njoɓdi maɓɓe arii wonaa e laabi gaadoraaɗi kono ko e jokkondiral luggiɗngal, ngal ƴaañii faamde aadee, noddi yimɓe ngam anndude goonga e laabi ɗi cikkataa. Laawol ngol oo maccuɗo Alla ina waɗi seedantaagal no ardaade waawirta feeñde e ngonkaaji ɓurɗi teeŋtude, ina nodda miijo e sifaa wahyu e hoore mum.
clues: Mi rokkaama nelal ummoraade e daande sirlu ummoraade e nokku mo yi’aaka.
Yimɓe am e fuɗɗoode njaɓaani konngol am, ina ɗaɓɓa seedeeji ɓurɗi laaɓtude e goonga am.
Miɗo ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe peewnata ko nanndi e ko keɓ-mi koo, kono ɓe mbaawaa.
Wahyu mo ngaddu-mi oo siforaama ko aayeeji laaɓtuɗi peeñninɗi goonga.
Mi jeertinii leñol am jukkungo tiiɗngo so tawii ɓe njokkii e keefeeraagal maɓɓe e mawnikinaare maɓɓe.
Daartol am ina haalee e sara nelaaɓe woɗɓe e nder suura teeŋtinoowo maandeeji baawɗe Alla.

options: Mi hootaama haa asama mi wuuri
Yimɓe am halkaama ngam warde gelooɗi kaawisaaji
Mi hisnaama e waɗeede e laana

arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful." (26:154)
